description: The Cigna Group, together with its subsidiaries, is a global health company committed to creating a better future for every individual and every community, powered by its dedicated people and valued brands, advancing its mission to improve the health and vitality of those it serves by staying grounded in the needs of its customers and patients and delivering a personalized, transparent and affordable health care experience, and focusing on leading the way to partner and innovate solutions for better health. Its global workforce of approximately 67,700 colleagues strives to fulfill that mission for more than 185 million customer relationships in more than 30 markets and jurisdictions as of December 31, 2025.
